note: 25-acre RV park, formerly Lakeside Camp Park, on a stocked private lake with a sandy swimming beach and off-shore raft, kayak and paddleboat rentals, a clubhouse and rec hall. Seasonal areas are mixed with nightly sites. Close to the highway; reviewers say the traffic noise is minor. --Claude
summary: Operator pages: $50 W/E and $55 full hookup plus $5/day electric for overnighters (stored $55-60, checked 2026-10-13, matches; left); 50-amp/water/sewer confirmed; 157 sites confirmed, to 40 ft with pull-throughs on Campspot (pull_through added; dropped the note's 'all on back-in pads', which Campspot contradicts); laundry, store, paid Wi-Fi; no public dump; Campspot booking. Military discount cleared (directory-only). Season May 1-Oct 31 already manual and matching. Price gate: $55 all-in exceeds US$50 but the park is 29 km from the Grand Rapids metro gateway.
flags: Seasonal share: the operator gives 157 sites 'with designated areas for seasonal guests' and sells seasons at $3,200-3,300 plus electric. Campspot lists only 10 nightly-type RV sites (6% of 157) plus 47 'Seasonal Standard/Lake' sites, which it also priced at $55-60 a night for October 2026 dates after most seasonals leave. If the seasonal types are not sold nightly in summer, under 1 site in 10 is nightly (long-stay test 4); June 2027 was not yet open on Campspot to check.

Price gate: $50 water/electric plus a mandatory $5/day electric charge for overnighters = $55 a night, over US$50, but within 40 km of the Grand Rapids metro gateway (29 km), so exempt. The family has not stayed here.
